document.purpose: Commercial Report Output Layer blocks for Full Report / Mobile Report / PDF / API rendering. Symbolic source unchanged.

commercial_report_blocks.opening_essence: Your S5 pattern, The Mission of Initiation, describes a meaningful direction your life may keep returning to. Your mission may invite you to begin what has been waiting for movement. This is a direction of inner maturation, not a fixed career, destiny, or external obligation.
commercial_report_blocks.how_this_may_show_up: You may recognize this mission through the impulse to move first, solve quickly, or begin again whenever life feels stagnant. When fear is leading, this can become impatience or pressure. When integrated, the same sensitivity becomes the mission of initiating movement with awareness. You are learning to turn urgency into clean beginnings, and personal drive into an invitation that helps others take their first honest step.
commercial_report_blocks.core_gift: The core gift of this mission is starting before certainty. It may naturally express through fields such as leadership, entrepreneurship, launches, pioneering ideas, and new communities, but it does not have to be limited to any one role or career.
commercial_report_blocks.growth_edge: The growth edge is to let this mission mature without turning it into pressure. When fear is leading, this mission may become impulsiveness that confuses speed with alignment.
commercial_report_blocks.integration_key: Integration begins when you stop trying to force a role and begin listening for what is already trying to move through your life more honestly.
commercial_report_blocks.one_week_practice: For one week, choose one small action that expresses this mission in real life. Keep it modest and concrete: one message, one decision, one boundary, one offer, one structure, or one moment of honest service. Notice what feels aligned rather than what looks impressive.
commercial_report_blocks.wisewave_reflection: Your mission is not a burden placed upon you. It is the shape your life begins to take when awareness becomes choice. You do not have to force meaning. You only have to stop abandoning what is true.
